changes_from_v1: width_resolution: wide W>3.0 -> clamp W_eff=3.0 (A/B) / bottleneck width_p10 (C), no abstention
safety_margin: global additive delta 3.1068 replaced by per-width-bin delta fitted on D2 train cities
applicability_domain: W upper bound removed (clamped); C type admitted via bottleneck width

nominal_model.note: c and p UNCHANGED from frozen v1

width_resolution.width_p10_def: 10th percentile of perpendicular cross-section width along the OBB long axis
width_resolution.note: wedge/tapered A/B cells are treated by the OBB clamp (not the bottleneck); accepted overprediction tradeoff

safety_margin.note: research-owner decision: utilization-priority. delta=0 for ALL widths; the margin was redundant with Q_low/C(W)/floor which already bound overprediction to <= +3 on D2.
safety_margin.rationale: D2 full-rule sweep (n=192): delta=0 -> util_med 68.4%, overpred 7.8% (max +3, total +20); delta=3.1 -> util_med 20.0%, overpred 0%. HK 13 valid: delta=0 -> util_med 56%, overpred 2 cells (+2,+1).

baseline_qualification.base_pass_rule: MEAN-based: mean_density<=1.20 AND 0.90<=mean_flow_ratio<=1.20 over q_r=0 seeds
